messages:
maria: Auditor emailed asking for end-to-end evidence for RBAC changes + KMS usage for the last 90 days. They want PR approvals, who executed the changes, CloudTrail/KMS logs, key rotation records, and a control mapping. Need a volunteer to assemble artifacts and narrative linking to SOC2/ISO controls. @sam @jess

sam: I can pull IAM and k8s rolebindings. Do we have a canonical list of roles to export or should I snapshot everything in prod cluster?

jess: I will map artifacts to SOC2 CC6.3 and ISO A.9.2. Auditor also asked for timestamps and explicit approval evidence (PR IDs + Jira ticket numbers).

maria: Ideal deliverables: PR URLs, terraform apply logs, change tickets (Jira), CloudTrail slice, KMS describe-key outputs (rotationEnabled, lastRotation, keyPolicy snapshot), and a short narrative mapping each artifact to control objective. Also need chain-of-custody (checksums + object versions).

lee: I can run exports. Proposed AWS commands to get a focused slice (example):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutRolePolicy --start-time 2024-08-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-30T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[*].{Time:EventTime,User:Username,Event:CloudTrailEvent}' --output json > /tmp/rbac-putrole-events.json

aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-primary --query '{KeyId:KeyMetadata.KeyId,Rotation:KeyMetadata.RotationEnabled,ARN:KeyMetadata.Arn,Creation:KeyMetadata.CreationDate,LastRotation:KeyMetadata.KeyRotationStatus}' > /tmp/kms-alias-redwood-primary.json
```

sam: Good. Also include CloudTrail events for DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, RotateKey and CloudWatch Logs for /aws/kms. Terraform apply logs live in CI S3: s3://redwood-ci-logs/terraform/applies/*. We should capture the apply job log for each terraform change.

jess: Auditor specifically wants proof of security approval. We tag PRs with label "sec-review" and require at least one security approver in the PR. I'll grep GH for label:sec-review repo:infrastructure and compile PR list and approver names.

external_auditor: Please include a short checklist mapping each artifact to the control objective, UTC timestamps, and a signed attestation that exported logs are unaltered. Also provide sampling methodology for why you chose the events/time window.

maria: Understood. I will sign the attestation once artifacts are compiled. Note: there was a vuln-driven emergency RBAC change on 2024-11-12 related to CVE-2024-XXXXX; link that to IR-2024-57 and VULN-341 in the bundle. Include the IR ticket and postmortem excerpt.

sam: Found terraform PR #1287 and CI apply job job-2024-11-12-apply. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/2024/11/12/job-2024-11-12-apply.log (will snapshot).

maria: Can someone capture KMS rotation history and key policy snapshots? I recall rotation enabled in 2023; auditor wants last rotation date.

lee: Done. Pushed outputs: /tmp/kms-alias-redwood-primary.json and cloudtrail slice. Uploaded to compliance bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1918765432/kms-describe.json (version v2) and s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1918765432/cloudtrail-rbac.json.gz

jess: I'll create the mapping document at control_mappings/1918765432_rbac_kms_mapping.md and include a table linking artifact -> control ID -> rationale. Will also list change approvers: maria, sam, and the security review alias.

external_auditor: Good. One final ask: provide S3 object version IDs and checksums so we can verify integrity.

maria: We'll include MD5 checksums and S3 version IDs. I'll also write a short sampling rationale: 90-day window chosen to cover the emergency change and two weeks prior to capture change context, include all terraform applies for infra repos, and sample 100 CloudTrail events around each apply for chain-of-custody.

sam: Plan: assemble artifacts into a zip with manifest.json (md5sums + s3-version IDs) and upload to s3://redwood-compliance/bundles/1918765432-evidence.zip by EOD UTC.

lee: Upload starting now...

infra-bot: Upload complete. s3://redwood-compliance/bundles/1918765432-evidence.zip (versionId:3q9a7b2c) MD5: abcdef1234567890

maria: Thanks team. Jess, once mapping doc and attestation are ready please send to the auditor and CC me. external_auditor please confirm receipt and if anything else is required.

external_auditor: Received the bundle and manifest. I'll validate checksums and PR evidence. If we need further sampling or deeper raw logs we'll request it, but this looks sufficient for the initial evidence package. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

maria: Great, closing this thread — will follow up if auditor asks for additional sampling or extended retention snapshots.
